decisions.reason: As a low-cost service complement to the installed base, the training programme preserves customer ties and supports machine sales, so its option value remains worth keeping.
The fourth rotary axis is a modular accessory closely tied to the firm’s core milling systems, and keeping such a niche add-on open is relatively inexpensive.
Hybrid additive post-processing is the most exploratory and least committed offer in the portfolio, so after several years its uncertain payoff no longer justifies continued commercialization effort.
A high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the heart of the firm’s competencies and customer demand, so despite higher carrying costs it is still a strategic option worth continuing.
The automatic tool change system is a strong complementary upgrade that leverages the firm’s modular engineering and installed base, making it attractive to retain on the market.
